first_pilot_reason: IA medical/prose exemplar first: individual page access and actual historical Greek print are demonstrated; dedupe and rights remain gates.
IA university-library stratum first, with the printed Greek story specimen as access/face evidence; new full-text hits require item rights and print checks.

Open Archives metadata triage first: byte-bound table provenance and a counted OCR pool exist. The clean reused pages do not establish scan status or usable yield; resolve that before a reading pilot.

Ajax Lobeck body pages first: paired human-corrected text, explicit scan sources and a high-density same-line witness. BSB Philologus is the strongest unlabelled complement. BCH has no measured same-line yield.
Take the Latin-only by-product of the same mixed pilot and keep the primary allocation disjoint; no extra acquisition quota inferred.

Russian Wikisource paired page first for reference work; for training, discover new IA editions after dedupe and the codec gate. Old Cyrillic-selected pages can be German-only, so test physical script.
BSB contents/heading bands first: the probe exposes large headings and preserved top bands. Measure heading detection/crop ownership before deciding a usable line yield.
ELSTAT historic statistical-publication access qualification first, then a bounded numeric-page pilot. No measured numeric-source yield is available, so no production quota is recommended.
BSB Philologus contents leaf first: visible genuine leaders give a concrete physical pilot. Count full leader ownership and printed dot runs; do not use ellipsis tags as evidence.

Pleias fiction/periodical metadata qualification first because a current item licence exists; qualify a short prose page path before spending on reads. Greek Wikisource is the strongest currently paired reference route.
